mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the monetary cycle remains in easing phase.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day forward returns in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.10, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95 and housing starts (HOUST) below 650 indicates concurrent supply-demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day forward returns in more than 55% of instances when both INDPRO and HOUST are below thresholds, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Robust GDP growth exceeding 2.0% annualized signals strong economic expansion that elevates corporate earnings and investor confidence, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day forward returns in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Residential mortgage credit growth exceeding 1.5% monthly signals heightened consumer spending momentum, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day forward returns in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS growth exceeds 1.5% monthly, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% per annum signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day forward returns in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95 and non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) below 130000 indicates concurrent manufacturing and labor market contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day forward returns in more than 55% of instances when both INDPRO and PAYEMS are below thresholds, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Residential mortgage credit growth exceeding 1.0% monthly during high consumer spending regimes elevates corporate revenue growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day forward returns in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS growth exceeds 1.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
